failed_attempts_and_rca.observed: All 30 profile runs passed, but S2-AC-01 failed because the external sampler missed short-lived executor child RSS in three byte-burst repetitions.
failed_attempts_and_rca.root_cause: Executor RSS was sampled only from instantaneous OS process-tree snapshots after short executor processes had already exited.
failed_attempts_and_rca.remediation: The queue worker now retains aggregate executor process-tree peak RSS in Prometheus and its heartbeat; the evidence runner merges that retained peak with instantaneous samples.

failed_attempts_and_rca.observed: A through C and the adaptive half of D passed; the CPU-one D worker exited and the suite stopped before E through J.
failed_attempts_and_rca.root_cause: A transient Windows reader lock caused atomic heartbeat replacement to raise WinError 5, which terminated the worker and removed its Prometheus target.
failed_attempts_and_rca.remediation: Heartbeat replacement now uses a short bounded retry and still fails closed if all attempts are exhausted.

claim_boundary: Controlled external HTTP, PostgreSQL, process, Prometheus, OTLP, and one-GPU evidence on one local physical node. No customer traffic, production SLA, physical-node HA, DR, or multi-GPU claim. S2 verification does not imply S3 or final S0-S8 system verification.
